Drove checkout.html, checkout-errors.html and assistant.html in headless Chromium with JavaScript on, using my own playwright-core scripts: empty submit, summary links, bad email, fix, Apply code, Pay (double press, Back), Enter key, Tab order at 375 and 1280, assistant actions. findings.where: screens/checkout.html, form#checkout, 375 and 1280, light; button "Apply code" (formaction=checkout.html formnovalidate) and every text field
findings.problem: Enter in any checkout field presses "Apply code", not Pay, and in this build both Enter and a click on "Apply code" reload the page with every typed value gone and no word about the code. "Apply code" is the form's default button because it is the first submit button in the form. Six fields carry enterkeyhint="next", so a phone keyboard promises "next" for a key that submits the form (iOS behaviour inferred, not run). The charter LOCK row "a person is not asked to re-enter information" is broken on the real screen.
findings.evidence: Script: first submit in form.elements = "Apply code". Filled the five required fields, focus in #postcode, pressed Enter: one navigation to /screens/checkout.html?email=sam%40example.com&name=Sam+Lee&...&code= ; afterwards all field values "" (country GB). Enter in #email with the rest empty: same navigation, error summary stays hidden. Click on "Apply code" after typing email, line2 "Flat 3", town "Leeds", code "WELCOME": same navigation, all values "", no aria-invalid, no message about the code, data-theme lost.
findings.fix: Take "Apply code" out of the paying form: give the code its own form (or form="…" on the field and button) so Pay is the only and default submit of form#checkout. Add a lint rule: in a form, no formnovalidate submit may come before the primary submit. Add an Enter-key assertion to check-noscript.mjs and a JS-on twin. Say in docs/components/button.md which button a form's Enter key presses. For the static screens, have the code form return to checkout.html#code and state that the page is not wired.

findings.where: src/components/cost-summary/cost-summary.css, total row dd; screens/checkout.html and checkout-errors.html at 320 and 375, light and dark
findings.problem: The total can leave its display, and what leaves is drawn in the display's light ink on the light panel, so the last digits cannot be read and the page scrolls sideways. Two triggers: text at 200 percent, and a long total without data-length="long". The charter row "text can be enlarged to 200%, no text clipped" fails on the real checkout.
findings.evidence: Root font 200% at 375 and at 320: scrollWidth 387 against 375 and 320; dd "£60.75" at 72px spans x=97 to 387 while the display ends at 311; screenshot shows the final "5" and "VAT" pale on pale. £12,345,678.90 at 320 without data-length: amount 281px wide in a 222px display, right edge 330, scrollWidth 330; the "0" falls outside. With data-length="long": 220 of 222px, so a 15-character total overflows again. At 375 it fits without the attribute (281 of 293).
findings.fix: In cost-summary.css let the total shrink or wrap instead of overflowing: a fluid size token (clamp between display-long and display against the display's own inline size, via a container query unit) and min-inline-size 0 with overflow-wrap on the dd as last resort, so data-length is no longer a manual step for live data. Add a 200% pass and a long-total fixture to check-screens.mjs.

findings.evidence: Root font 200% at 375 and 320: scrollWidth 454; h2, ul, li and both links report right edge 454; p.sv-field__error scrollWidth 374 against clientWidth 245. findings.where: src/base/base.css .sv-list__main; src/components/proposal/proposal.css draft and dd; screens/checkout.html and assistant.html at 320, 375, 1280
findings.problem: A long unbroken string in data the screen author does not write (a catalogue item name, an event name, a link inside a drafted message) pushes the page sideways. data-user-content only works inside .sv-chat-message, so there is no way to mark such text elsewhere.
findings.evidence: 90 characters, no spaces, as the first item name: scrollWidth 655 at 320 and 375, 1295 at 1280; the name runs from x=33 to 655 through the panel edge (304 at 320). findings.evidence: Script, 375: button not inside sv-button, data-busy-label null. Two clicks 60 ms apart with the response held 800 ms: two submits not prevented, two requests to assistant-done.html, aria-busy null, label unchanged. The same test on Pay gives one request and "Paying £60.75…".

findings.where: src/components/field/field.js and error-summary.js; screens/checkout.html at 375 with JavaScript on
findings.problem: An error that appears when a person leaves a field is not announced, and the summary can contradict the field. The error line has no live-region role, so a screen reader user who tabs on hears nothing until submit (charter row "status messages are announced without moving focus"). The page title also stays "Checkout" after a failed submit, while the server-rendered error page is titled "Error: Checkout". The busy label on Pay changes the button's name outside any live region.
findings.evidence: Typed "sam@" in #email, Tab: focus on #name; #email aria-invalid=true; error text "Enter an email address with an @, like name@example.com."; p#email-error role null, aria-live null. Summary still lists "Enter your email address." After empty submit document.title is "Checkout". What is right: summary role=alert, tabindex -1, aria-labelledby, takes focus; each control has aria-describedby with hint and error; fixing the email removes its summary item.
findings.fix: In field.js keep the error line in the page as a polite live region (or set role=alert when a blur check fails); in error-summary.js update a listed link's text on sv-field-invalid and prefix the title with "Error: " while the summary shows. Add these three assertions to the JS-on check.

findings.where: screens/checkout.html:131 (Apply code) and :138 (Pay); same in screens/checkout-errors.html:134/141; guidance in briefs/v0.2-build-spec.md "Buttons and links"

Pressing Enter in any field submits through it: no validation, no busy state, the page reloads and everything typed is gone. Same with scripts off.

With only the email typed: Enter -> checkout.html?email=sam%40example.com&name=&line1=..., error summary hidden=true, aria-invalid count 0.

findings.where: src/components/button/button.js:30-56 (handleEvent, start); restore only on pageshow with persisted
findings.problem: Once busy, the button stays busy for ever if the page is not replaced: the server answers 204 or a download, the form has a target, or the navigation is stopped. findings.problem: AGENTS.md says the checks enforce rules 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 8 "and will fail your screen if you break them". Of 16 bad pages, 11 passed both lint and the screen checker in every state. MISSED: 01 a div with role=button and an a.sv-button with no href (rule 6); 02b 32px text coloured with a font element (rules 1, 3); 03 headings faked with p.sv-error-summary__title, strong and role=heading (rule 8); 04 inputs with only aria-label, a visually hidden label, or aria-labelledby to a missing id (rule 7); 05 a message with data-tone="busy" or no tone, a button with data-tone and data-size (rule 2); 08 no viewport meta, lang or title; 09 a primary type=button outside any form and a form with action="#" (rule 6); 10 hidden messages that show; 11 a required sv-field with no error line; 12b sv-field__error, sv-list__detail and sv-proposal__draft on stray text; 13 img without alt, a bordered table, dialog open, an invented sv-tabs element and a progress bar. CAUGHT: 06 second primary inside details (lint html-many-primary, checker many-accent-fills); 07 native radio and checkbox in plain labels (checker focus-outline only; lint and target size pass); 12 sv-cost-summary and sv-chat-message on a p (checker only); a link inside the cost summary (checker, 1.08:1); 02 body-size font colour (checker text-contrast, dark theme only).
findings.evidence: Lint via lintFile() printed "LINT PASSES" for all but 06; "node scripts/check-screens.mjs --dir <bad>" table showed pass in all six columns for 01, 03, 04, 05, 08, 09, 10, 11, 13, 02b, 12b. Screenshot of 13 shows the dialog over the h1 and a native blue progress bar.
findings.fix: Lint: an allow-list of elements and attributes (no font, center, color, bgcolor, border, align, size; no img without alt, dialog, table, progress; only the three defined sv- elements); role=button or tabindex on a non-control; a.sv-button without href; type=button outside a named wrapper; each sv- class allowed only on its element and inside its parent; option values checked per component, and data-tone required on sv-message; a label must be visible (aria-label alone, a visually hidden label and an unresolved aria-labelledby fail); viewport, lang and title required. Until then, reword AGENTS.md:16 to say which forms of each rule are checked.

findings.where: src/components/cost-summary/ beside the nine general parts; tokens: semantic.*.color.inverse, semantic.font.size.display and display-long; dist/souvenir.css
findings.problem: src/base itself holds nothing commerce-only.
